digest.component_or_area: Git reclaim-backup helper and bundle preparation
propositions: Create an off-repository Git bundle and JSON manifest recording live origin heads/tags, old tip, and pin tips with exact OIDs and ancestry relationships, refusing any existing artifacts or paths inside worktrees/Git directories.

Enumerate all remote heads/tags at execution time via git ls-remote, collapse annotated-tag peeled OIDs onto canonical refs, and classify each commit ref's relationship to the old tip (same, ancestor, descendant, diverged, unrelated, or non-commit).

Use a run-unique temporary clone namespace under refs/reclaim-backup/ that refuses partial clones, creates explicit temporary refs for the bundle, verifies the bundle with git bundle verify, and removes only the owned namespace in finally block.
Verify bundle integrity by restoring to a throwaway repository and comparing restored old-tip and pin-tip OIDs exactly, while confirming no remote mutations (push/delete) occurred before and after.
